svg.text: GL5528 photoresistor divider: 3V3 - LDR - GP28 - 10k - GND, + OLED
the junction is NOT a wire: it is just the
breadboard row GP28 plugs into (LDR low
leg + 10k high leg both land there)
brighter light -> LDR drops -> GP28 rises
Maker Lab Kids · Pico 2 W · numbers outside the board are physical header pins
